name: Tom Leek
stance: Sponsor of SB 482, the AI Bill of Rights, restricting companion chatbots for minors and requiring AI disclosure.

statements.text: Sponsored SB 482, the Artificial Intelligence Bill of Rights, which passed the Florida Senate 35-2.
There's an inherent evilness when we allow machines to create and sustain a relationship that a user believes to be real.
